task_type: public responsive image delivery and navigation performance
requested_outcome: Deliver sharper card photography through responsive Cloudflare image derivatives, preserve verified media identity and fallbacks, and reduce unnecessary image bytes without changing approved VII content or flows.
natural_destination: Public VII search and shared card families on desktop and 390-pixel mobile, backed by the existing R2 media store and Cloudflare Images binding.
authorization_boundary: Implement, test and publish one verified performance release after v774. Do not change source media, business data, DNS, schemas, secrets, permissions or content identity.

lesson_bundle.reason: Performance exists only when the exact public release loads and navigates correctly.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact-version public HTTP, visual and interaction evidence after deployment.

lesson_bundle.reason: The change affects public venue photography.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve the approved source image and crop, and never invent or upscale venue content.

lesson_bundle.reason: Responsive image selection must work at the primary mobile viewport.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify chosen derivative, crop, loading and fallback at 390 pixels.

lesson_bundle.reason: PreviewCardGallery is shared by several public worlds.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify the shared card family across vacation, event, spa, discovery and map selection.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a delivery optimization, not a redesign.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve layout, copy, galleries, booking actions, URLs and source media order.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Images look sharper in one card but fail or change identity elsewhere.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one allowlisted responsive image component with original-source fallback and apply it only to shared result-card media.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Vacation and shared preview cards retain the same original image identity and recover to the original URL when optimization fails.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The optimizer works for static assets but returns 404 for migrated R2 gallery images.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Teach the Worker optimizer to read only validated local gallery filenames directly from the existing R2 binding.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A real R2 gallery derivative returns 200 with an image content type and immutable cache headers.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Quality improves by downloading oversized images and the site becomes slower.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Emit bounded 384, 640, 750 and 828 pixel derivatives with sizes metadata and no source upscaling beyond the card need.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Browser selects a viewport-appropriate derivative and transferred bytes are lower than the original for representative cards.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Above-the-fold images remain late while every card is eagerly downloaded.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Prioritize only the first three non-map search cards and keep all later and map-card images lazy.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: First three result images are eager or high priority, later images remain lazy, and no bulk eager load occurs.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A focused image fix breaks galleries, sliders, booking, navigation or mobile layout.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep component structure and interactions unchanged and run focused plus affected-family regression and production build.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Gallery arrows, swipe, links, booking actions, desktop and mobile layouts continue to work.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the secure R2 optimizer source and shared responsive card image component are implemented, before broad replacement or build.
checks: unsafe and unknown media paths are rejected
a valid R2 object becomes an optimizer source response
responsive card markup contains bounded srcset and sizes with original fallback
only above-the-fold search cards receive priority

attack_questions: Can path traversal or a non-image object be fetched through the optimizer?
Can a derivative failure leave a broken card instead of the original image?
Can the shared change swap a venue's approved cover or crop mode?
Can mobile download an 828-pixel derivative when 384 is sufficient?
Can priority loading trigger for every card or map result?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Inspect exact public candidate cards and optimizer responses on desktop and 390-pixel mobile after deployment.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused security and markup tests, shared-family regression, production build and public sampling across the changed worlds.

effectiveness.baseline: Public card images use raw R2 files with no srcset, dynamic R2 optimizer requests return 404, and only some shared card families can mark images as priority.
effectiveness.target: Zero broken or mismatched changed-family images, valid responsive derivatives, and lower representative card-image transfer size than v774.
